R1.text: Mount on the TM pattern (4 x M5 on 80 x 80, 2 x Ø5 dowels): on Gyropup's head or on the stand

R2.text: Pan continuously (a slip ring passes power and signals), 3:1 off an STS3215, with an absolute index at pan 0; gated over +-170 deg

R3.text: Tilt 0 to -25 deg between hard stops: the barrel never points above level

R5.text: Hand one ball at a time to the flywheels, three a second; parked, powered or not, no ball reaches the wheels

R6.text: Feed, squeeze and fire any Rival-compatible round of 22.2-22.8 mm and 1.6-2.0 g

checks.message: no gate 'turret-ammo' (known: wall, connectivity, containment, fasteners, motion, assembly)

R7.text: A Hasbro round leaves at 95-100 fps; no accepted round above 105 fps, the densest under ASTM F963's 2,500 J/m^2

R8.text: The ball's way from the exit pocket to the muzzle is clear: only the tyres touch it, at the nip

checks.message: no gate 'turret-path' (known: wall, connectivity, containment, fasteners, motion, assembly)

R9.text: Every part is held: nothing in the model floats

R10.text: Nothing collides over the aim's range (pan +-170 x tilt 0..-25) or the mechanisms' (the dial, the flywheels, the flap, the pinion), with the hopper loaded

R11.text: Every gated screw seats, engages its insert and can be driven with its key

R12.text: The turret goes together in its build order, each part along a straight path

R13.text: Strength: SF 1.2 on the rare cases (falls), 2.0 on the everyday ones, layer-aware for printed parts

R14.text: Every part is bought at a listed price, printed, or cut at an instant online price

R15.text: The turret carries its own Jetson Orin NX 16 GB and takes one XT30 input, 12-54 V

R16.text: The turret stands alone on one DCB609 FLEXVOLT in 20 V mode, with the hold-to-run pendant

R17.text: Every slip-ring circuit carries at most 2 A, on the bus and on the stand's pack

R18.text: Nothing spins unless ARM is held; the chronograph trips at 105 fps

R19.text: Show the aim with a laser parallel to the bore, under 1 mW (Class 2)
